entries.def:
ὁρμή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Pro.3.25 (שׁוֹא), etc. ;] 
__1. a violent movement, impulse: Jas.3.4 
__2. a hostile movement, onset, assault. Act.14.5.†
(AS)

ὅρμημα, -τος, τό
(ὁρμάω) [in LXX: Hos.5.10, Amo.1.11 (עֶבְרָה), etc. ;] 
a rush: Rev.18.21.†
(AS)

ὄρνεον, -ου, τό = ὄρνις, 
[in LXX chiefly for צִפּוֹר ;] 
a bird: Rev.18.2; 19.17, 21 (Hom., al.).†
(AS)

ὄρνις, -ιθος, ὁ, ἡ 
[in LXX: ὄ. ἐκλεκταί, I2Ki.3:1 4:23 (1Ki.5.3) (בַּרְבֻּר)* ;] 
a bird; specif., a cock, a hen: Mat.23.3, Luk.13.34 (WH).†
(AS)

ὁροθεσία, -ας, ἡ
(ὅρος, a boundary, + τίθημι) 
a setting of boundaries; in pl., bounds; Act.17.26.†
(AS)

ὄρος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly, and very freq., for הַר ;] 
a mountain: Mat.4.8; 17.1, Mrk.9.2, Jhn.4.20, 2Pe.1.18, al.; opposite to βουνός, Luk.3.5 (LXX); ὄ. τ. ἐλαιῶν, Mat.21.1; 24.3, al. (see: ἐ.); ὄ. Σιών (Σ., prob. in gem appos.), Heb.12.22, Rev.14.1; ὄ. Σινά, Act.7.30, 38 Gal.4.24-25; τὸ ὄ., of the hill district as distinct from the lowlands, esp. the hills above the Sea of Galilee, Mat.5.1; 8.1, Mrk.3.13;…

ὀρύσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for חָפַר also for כָּרָה, etc. ;] 
to dig: with accusative, ληνόν, Mat.21.33 ὁπολήνιον, Mrk.12.1 γῆν, Mat.25.18 (cf. δι-, ἐξ-ορύσσω).†
(AS)

ὀρφανός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for יָתוֹם ;] 
__1. prop., orphan, fatherless: Mrk.12.40, WH, mg, Jas.1.27. 
__2. In a general sense (as also in cl.; see LS, see word; and cf. MM, xviii), bereft, friendless, desolate: Jhn.14.18.†
(AS)

ὀρχέομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX for רָקַד, etc. ;] 
to dance; Mat.11.17; 14.6, Mrk.6.22, Luk.7.32.†
(AS)

ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, 
the postpositive article (ἄρθρον ὑποτακτικόν). 
__I. As demonstr. pron. = οὗτος, ὅδε, this, that, also for αὐτός, chiefly in nom.: ὅς δέ, but he (cf. ἦ δὲ ὅς, frequently in Plat.), Mrk.15.23, Jhn.5.11; ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, the one . . . the other, Mat.21.35; 22.5; 25.15, Luk.23.33, Act.27.14, Rom.14.5, 1Co.11.21, 2Co.2.18, Jude.22; neut., ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δέ, the one . . . the other, some . . . some,…
